title.zh: LZ-60和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both use a 6105 engine line. LZ-60 prints 145 kW, 50 m³/h and separate distance and height labels. Diesel 50 prints 99 kW and one H / V pair.
description.zh: 两边都用 6105 发动机行。LZ-60 印 145 kW、50 m³/h，距离和高度分成两个标题。柴油50印 99 kW 和一组水平/垂直。

h1.zh: LZ-60和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: LZ-60 and Diesel 50 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, outlet pressure 30 MPa and distance 150 m / 450 m. Dimensions on LZ-60 are in metres: 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Diesel 50 prints millimetres.
directAnswer.zh: LZ-60 和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、泵送压力 35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、出口压力 30 MPa、距离 150 m / 450 m。LZ-60 的外形以米为单位：6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。柴油50以毫米印出。

heading.en: Where LZ-60 and Diesel 50 print different values

body.en: Theoretical output: LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h; Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Dimensions: LZ-60 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m; Diesel 50 prints 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：LZ-60印 50 m³/h；柴油50印 30 m³/h。外形尺寸：LZ-60印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m；柴油50印 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: LZ-60 prints cells that Diesel 50 does not: Model line LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132; Engine power 6105 / 145 kW; Pumping pressure 35 MPa; Conveying distance 100 m; Delivery height 300 m. Diesel 50 prints cells that LZ-60 does not: Diesel engine power 6105 / 99 kW; Max. outlet pressure 30 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 140. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: LZ-60有、柴油50没有的行：型号行 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132；发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW；泵送压力 35 MPa；输送距离 100 m；输送高度 300 m。柴油50有、LZ-60没有的行：柴油机功率 6105 / 99 kW；最大出口压力 30 MPa；料斗容积 0.4 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 140。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The unit on the dimension line changes between these two pages. Read the unit before comparing length. Open /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60 and /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 这两页外形尺寸的单位不同。比较长度之前先看单位。看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does LZ-60 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 50?
question.zh: LZ-60和柴油50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。LZ-60印 50 m³/h。柴油50印 30 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does LZ-60 print the same dimensions as Diesel 50?
question.zh: LZ-60和柴油50的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Diesel 50 prints 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。LZ-60印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。柴油50印 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on Diesel 50?
question.zh: 为什么柴油50没有型号行？

answer.en: The Diesel 50 page does not print that label. LZ-60 prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油50这一页没有印这个标题。LZ-60印的是 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。

question.en: Where is the diesel engine power for Diesel 50 printed?
question.zh: 柴油50的柴油机功率印在哪里？

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ as 6105 / 99 kW. It is not printed as that label on the LZ-60 page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/，数值为 6105 / 99 kW。LZ-60页面没有这个标题。
